items.source: IdentifierAccessor that is aware of the target bean to obtain the identifier from so that it can generate a more meaningful exception in case of an absent identifier and a call to getRequiredIdentifier().
items.translation: 一个能够感知目标 Bean 以从中获取标识符的IdentifierAccessor，以便在标识符缺失且调用getRequiredIdentifier()时生成更具意义的异常。

items.source: Returns the identifier of the underlying instance. Implementations are strongly recommended to extends either TargetAwareIdentifierAccessor or override this method to add more context to the exception being thrown in case of the absence of an identifier.
items.translation: 返回底层实体的标识符。强烈建议实现类扩展TargetAwareIdentifierAccessor或重写此方法，以便在缺少标识符时向抛出的异常添加更多上下文信息。

items.source: Returns the identifier of the underlying instance.
items.translation: 返回底层实例的标识符。
接口 IdentifierAccessor 中的方法 getRequiredIdentifier
